name: Light Bowgun
author: RaintDM
entries: Ammo DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Dexterity modifier

rows: Mastery (Slow), Rapid Fire, Magazine, Reload, Evading Reload
Normal Ammo, Pierce Ammo, Spread Ammo
Magazine Upgrade I, Special Ammo, Wyvernblast
Recover Ammo, Flaming Ammo, Water Ammo, Thunder Ammo, Freeze Ammo
Magazine Upgrade II, Special Ammo Upgrade I, Wyvernblast Upgrade I
Poison Ammo, Paralysis Ammo, Explosive/Sticky Ammo
Rapid Fire Upgrade I, Magazine Upgrade III, Special Ammo Upgrade II, Counter Mine, Ammunition Damage Upgrades
Magazine Upgrade IV, Special Ammo Upgrade III, Wyvernblast Upgrade II

customFeatures.name: Mastery (Slow)
customFeatures.description: If you hit a creature with this weapon and deal damage to it, you can reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is hit more than once by weapons that have this property, the Speed reduction doesn't exceed 10 feet.

customFeatures.name: Rapid Fire
customFeatures.description: When you take the Attack action and attack with this weapon, you can make one additional attack with it as a Bonus Action.

customFeatures.name: Magazine
customFeatures.description: The weapon holds a maximum of 6 loaded rounds at a time. When the magazine reaches 0, you must reload it before you can fire again.

customFeatures.name: Reload
customFeatures.description: You can fully reload your magazine using an Action or a Bonus Action. When you do so, you choose the type of ammunition the weapon will contain.

customFeatures.name: Evading Reload
customFeatures.description: The weapon is designed to be reloaded using the momentum of your body. Once per turn, if you move at least 15 feet in a straight line, you can fully reload your magazine as part of that movement without expending an action.

customFeatures.name: Normal Ammo
customFeatures.description: Deals the weapon's base damage (1d6 Piercing) to a single target.

customFeatures.name: Pierce Ammo
customFeatures.description: You fire in a 30-foot line that is 5 feet wide. Make a single attack roll and compare it against the AC of each creature in that line. All creatures hit take the weapon's normal damage.

customFeatures.name: Spread Ammo
customFeatures.description: Instead of making an attack roll, you fire a 10-foot cone. Each creature in the cone must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 Piercing damage.

customFeatures.name: Magazine Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: Your magazine capacity increases to 8 rounds of standard ammunition (Normal, Pierce, or Spread).

customFeatures.name: Special Ammo
customFeatures.description: Due to barrel pressure limits, you can load a maximum of 2 Special Ammo rounds into the magazine during a reload. Once these are expended, you must reload to switch back to another ammunition type.

customFeatures.name: Recover Ammo
customFeatures.description: Instead of taking damage, a willing creature hit by this ammo regains 1d4 hit points.

customFeatures.name: Flaming Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal Fire damage instead of Piercing damage.

customFeatures.name: Water Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal Acid damage instead of Piercing damage.

customFeatures.name: Thunder Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

customFeatures.name: Freeze Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal Cold damage instead of Piercing damage.

customFeatures.name: Wyvernblast
customFeatures.description: As a Bonus Action, you can plant a Wyvernblast charge on the ground in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, or shoot it into a creature within 30 feet. When a creature within 5 feet of the charge takes damage from an attack or spell, the charge detonates, dealing 1d6 Fire damage to all creatures within 5 feet of it. The charge lasts for 1 minute or until it detonates 3 times. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Long Rest.

customFeatures.name: Magazine Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: Your magazine capacity increases to 10 rounds.

customFeatures.name: Special Ammo Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: Your magazine can now hold up to 4 Special Ammo rounds.

customFeatures.name: Wyvernblast Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: The damage of your Wyvernblast detonations increases to 1d8 Fire damage.

customFeatures.name: Poison Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal 1d4 Poison damage. The target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against your Ammo DC or have the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn.

customFeatures.name: Paralysis Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal 1d4 Lightning damage. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Ammo DC. On a failure, it becomes Paralyzed until the end of their next turn.

customFeatures.name: Explosive/Sticky Ammo
customFeatures.description: Your attacks with this ammo deal 1d4 Fire damage and produce an explosion in a 5-foot radius. Every creature in that area must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw against your Ammo DC or suffer 2d4 Fire damage and have the Prone condition.

customFeatures.name: Rapid Fire Upgrade I
customFeatures.description: When you use your Rapid Fire feature to make an attack as a Bonus Action, you can make two attacks instead of one.

customFeatures.name: Magazine Upgrade III
customFeatures.description: Your magazine capacity increases to 12 rounds.

customFeatures.name: Special Ammo Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: Your magazine can now hold up to 6 Special Ammo rounds.

customFeatures.name: Counter Mine
customFeatures.description: If a creature hits you with a melee attack, you can use your Reaction to embed a Wyvernblast charge directly into the attacker and detonate it instantly. This expends one use of your Wyvernblast and causes all three detonations simultaneously.

customFeatures.name: Sleep Ammo
customFeatures.description: If the target has 50 Hit Points or fewer, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or fall Unconscious for 1 minute, or until it takes damage or someone uses an action to shake it awake.

customFeatures.name: Dragon Ammo
customFeatures.description: The attack deals an extra 2d6 Necrotic damage, and the target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn.

customFeatures.name: Ammunition Damage Upgrades
customFeatures.description: Your Normal, Pierce, and Spread Ammo now deal an extra 1d8 Piercing damage. Your Flaming, Water, Thunder, and Freeze Ammo now deal an extra 1d8 damage of their respective types. Your Recover Ammo now restores 2d4 + your Proficiency Bonus hit points.

customFeatures.name: Magazine Upgrade IV
customFeatures.description: Your magazine capacity increases to 15 rounds.

customFeatures.name: Special Ammo Upgrade III
customFeatures.description: Your magazine can now hold up to 10 Special Ammo rounds.

customFeatures.name: Wyvernblast Upgrade II
customFeatures.description: The damage of your Wyvernblast detonations increases to 1d10 Fire damage. Additionally, you can now plant or shoot a Wyvernblast charge as part of the Attack action instead of requiring a Bonus Action.
